attr.title: retsurf
attr.desc: A lightweight, gamepad-first web browser powered by the Servo rendering engine. It renders modern websites over OpenGL ES with no X11 or Wayland compositor, and is driven entirely from the gamepad: a virtual cursor, Vimium-style link hints, and an on-screen keyboard. Tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, real page zoom, reader mode, and network-level ad and tracker blocking are all built in.
